Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game! What a win for England and they have levelled the series! They will go into the last game with confidence and will hope that they can win it. Australia, on the other hand, will be a disappointed bunch as they have given away a victory which was within their reach. They will look to perform better and try to win it in the next game. The third and final ODI will be played on 16th September, 2020 at 1300 local (1200 GMT). Join us for that, cheers and take care.

Eoin Morgan, England's skipper, says that this win is a confidence booster for his team and is very pleased with the way they played. Gives full credit to everyone. Says that Adil Rashid was outstanding towards the end. In a 50-over game, Morgan believes that it is important to know when to get going and believes his side did that well.

Jofra Archer is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he bowled really well with the new ball first up. Jofra says all the English bowlers bowled well. On the win, Archer says that his captain, Morgan, wanted to win this one and hence everyone put in the required effort to do so. Jofra says that he is not aware of the deterioration of the pitch and just focused on the task at hand.

Aaron Finch, the Aussie skipper, says that he always felt that the match was going to be tough. States that England bowled straight and well. He adds that at times things do not go according to plans and believes they will be better in the future. In the future, Aaron says that his bowlers will also tighten the lengths a little bit and bowl straighter lines. On the track, Aaron says that it progressively deteriorated and hence batting became difficult.
Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony!!!

Earlier in the game, Australia restricted the hosts to 231 but they would be disappointed that they let them off the hook in the death overs as the home side scored over 50 in the last 4 overs and that gave England the momentum. England would be happy that they reached 231 in the end after being 149 for 8 and the total proved to be enough in the end as Archer and Woakes ran havoc with the ball.

What to speak about Australia? They have done a repeat of what they had done in the first T20I! They were winning easily at one stage but it is never over when the Aussies are concerned. They collapsed from 144 for 2 to 147 for 6 and never recovered from there. Alex Carey was left a little too much to do and he was struggling to find the boundaries when it was needed. It was really important for a set batsman to stay out there and finish it but Finch and Labuschagne got out at the wrong time to give England the honours.

England's bowling was top notch! Archer started it all, picking up Warner and Stoinis at the start. Just when it looked all over for England, Morgan brought out his majestic captaincy to the fore. He brought on Archer and Woakes back on and they delivered. They reduced the visitors to 147 for 6 from 144 for 2 and left them in complete tatters. Many might have questioned as to why he is leaving the lesser experienced bowlers for the death but it worked wonders. Sam Curran prized out 3 wickets for himself while his brother Tom kept it tight at the death. Adil Rashid had an off day but he too was brilliant in his last few overs. All in all, they were brilliant and have pulled a rabbit out of a hat.

Wow, what a game! What a victory for England! They have made a remarkable comeback from a precarious position and have levelled the series with a terrific victory! All credit has to go to their bowlers for snatching a victory from the jaws of defeat. Australia were 144 for 2 at one stage and it looked like it will be Australia who will take the honours but England never gave up and have won the game from nowhere.

OUT! STUMPED! What a comeback from Rashid, what a comeback from England! Buttler has been excellent behind the stumps as well! Rashid bowls a googly, slower through the air. Carey puts the dancing shoes on and skips down the track and looks to power this over mid-wicket for a biggie. He though ends up missing it badly and Buttler collects and does the rest. ENGLAND WIN BY 24 RUNS!
Play and a miss! Tosses this outside off, Carey goes for the sweep but misses it.

Should have been more tight there, England! Flatter ball on middle and leg, Hazlewood looked to work that on the leg side but misses. It goes towards backward point after deflecting from his pads. A quick leg bye is taken as the throw is in at the striker's end but Carey scampers in quickly.
Adil loops this on middle and leg, Alex sweeps but only to square leg. Just the one.
Good length ball on middle, Carey flicks it to square leg and crosses over for a single to keep strike.
Short ball on middle, Carey pulls it to long on and takes a quick couple.
FOUR! Need more of this, Carey! Australia hanging on! Good length ball outside off, Carey powers it over mid off for a boundary. 30 from 14.
On a length outside off, Hazlewood punches it to deep cover for a single.
On a length on off, Carey pushes it to cover and takes a single.
Full ball on middle, Hazlewood works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Strong shot from Carey! Full and on middle and leg, he goes down and sweeps this hard, past mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, Hazlewood works this to the on side for one.
Flights this on leg, Alex works this down the ground to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Tom Curran right at the edge at short third man there! Flatter ball, the reverse sweep is out, it goes just over Curran as the fielder jumps and gets a feather on it. It goes past and a couple is sneaked in.
On the shorter side again, Josh tucks it to mid-wicker for a single.
Flatter wrong 'un on off, Carey nudges that to deep square leg off his back foot and crosses over for a single.
Adil Rashid is coming back on. 8-0-56-0, his figures so far.
Length delivery down the leg side, worked to square leg for a single. Carey keeps strike.
A dot! Carey goes to the leg side and looks to cut but gets a bottom edge back on to the ground.
Full length delivery down the leg side, Hazlewood drives to long on for one.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Carey hops and works this to point and gets to the other end.

A hurried run there! Shortish length delivery on top of the stumps, Hazlewood looked to play it on the leg side but misses and gets it on his body. It falls back on to the track and Carey wants a quick single. He makes it in safely as Curran flicks that off his boots. A leg bye then.
Full on off and middle, Hazlewood glances that to mid-wicket for a dot.

Hazlewood keeps the strike! Good length ball on middle, Hazlewood works it to deep square leg and takes the single. 51 needed from the last 5 overs. Tom Curran finishes with 10-2-28-0. Excellent stuff.
Only a single! Short ball on middle, Carey pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Hazlewood will have one ball to face.
Hit hard but straight to the fielder! Full ball outside off, Carey drives it hard but it goes straight to the extra cover fielder.
Slower ball outside off, Carey backs away and looks to cut but misses. 53 from 33.
Good length ball on middle, Hazlewood flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball on off, Carey makes room and punches it to long on. They want the couple but decide against it. Hazlewood comes on strike.
On a length on middle and leg, Alex looked to work that on the leg side but ends up getting an inside edge on to his pads. It goes to the off side off the deflection and a single is taken.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! England are all over Australia here! Adam Zampa goes, 2 off 19 deliveries. Curran from around the wicket, bowls this short of a length on middle and leg, Zampa looked to loft that on the leg side. He though ends up getting a top edge, which goes sky-high behind the bowler. Archer comes running in from mid off and takes it safely. Right, so only Carey can do it now!
Fullish on the stumps, Zampa looked to loft this on the off side but gets an inside edge on to his pads.
Full and in the blockhole outside off, Adam looked to dig it out but misses out completely.

Half an appeal for a caught behind, Sam thought he heard something, Buttler nothing! Zampa backs away and looked to play this length delivery on the off side. He though misses and the ball goes past to Buttler.
On a good length on top of off, Carey guides it to mid on and gets to the other end.
Good length delivery on the leg pole line, Zampa goes to the leg side and hits that but straight to the man at short mid-wicket. A dot.
Full ball on middle, Carey plays that to mid on. Just the single.
Pitches it short does Curran, Zampa drives that past him off his back foot. It goes to long on for one.
Short and on top of  the stumps, Zampa looks to pull but fails to connect.
Full length ball on off, Carey strokes that to wide mid on and takes a single.
On middle, Carey pushes this towards cover-point. A dot and these are not helping Australia's cause one bit.
A dot to finish. Length delivery on top of the stumps, Zampa goes for the ramp shot but misses to connect.
Full and on middle, Zampa defends it out off his front foot.
Does not get it through the packed off side field! Full and outside off, Adam drives again but straight to Morgan at extra cover.
Fullish and around off, Zampa drives but finds cover-point.
Full length delivery on middle, Zampa defends this out to mid on.

Bangs it short and wide outside off, Carey cuts it fiercely towards deep point. There should have been just the couple but the relay which was a bit wayward allows an extra run to be stolen. Three in total.
Full on off, Zampa pushes it to mid off. 63 needed from 54 deliveries.
Tom bowls a good length ball on off, Adam punches it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball on the pads, Carey nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on the pads, Zampa works it to fine leg for a single.
On a length on off, Zampa defends it to mid off.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Carey looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
The umpire signals for the third Powerplay! 5 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the game!
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Zampa presents the full face of the bat and defends. 2 wickets off that Sam Curran over, excellent!
Full length delivery on off and middle, Zampa blocks.
Full on middle, blocked. The hat-trick ball is kept away safely by Zampa.
Adam Zampa comes out to face the Hat-Trick ball!

OUT! CAUGHT! Starc knows he has edged it and hence he starts walking. 2 in 2 for Sam Curran and it is all but England's game now! Sam dishes out a length delivery, outside off, from around the wicket. Starc looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes low to Buttler who does well to lunge forward and take that. Oh, how have Australia lost the plot completely here!
Mitchell Starc is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Sam Curran's plan to bowl it from around the wicket has payed dividends! Ambitious shot from Cummins but it was not that short at all to pull. Langer is fuming with despair. Sam bowls a shortish one on top of off from round the wicket, Cummins looks to pull but gets an inside edge and the ball goes behind and disturbs the woodwork. Australia are crumbling here.
Length ball outside off, Carey works that towards third man for a single. He wanted the second but the throw was in quickly, at the striker's end.
Sam Curran is back on. He has bowled 4 overs for 16 runs.
On a length on off, Cummins pushes it to mid off. Just 3 from the over. 67 needed from 66 balls.
Slower short ball on middle, Cummins looks to flick but it bounces a little extra and hits him on the top half of the bat and goes towards square leg.
Good length ball on off, Carey taps it to third man and takes a single.
On a length on off, Cummins guides it to third man for a single.
On a length outside off, Carey drives it to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
Good length ball on off, Carey defends it to cover.
Flatter ball outside off, Cummins looks to defend without getting too close to the line of the ball and hence does not make contact.
Flighted on middle, Cummins presents the full face of his bat and defends.
Tosses this on middle, Cummins works it to point. A dot.
SIX! Good shot, strong shot, a maximum! Adil loops this on off, Cummins comes forward and lofts this mightily over long on for a maximum.
BEATEN! Excellent flight there from Rashid. He tosses the leg break on off, it spins away as Cummins looked to have a go at that.
Looped up on the stumps, Cummins drives that on the off side.
On off, pushed to mid off.

An appeal from Curran for LBW but it was going down the leg side. Bowls this short of a good length on middle and leg, from round the wicket. Carey looked to play at it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal follows but umpire Gough says no.
Back of a length delivery, Carey defends this out to the mid on fielder.
Play and a miss! Length ball around the off pole, Carey hops and looks to keep it out but fails to connect.
Length delivery on off from round the wicket, defended to the leg side for a dot.
On the pads, Cummins looks to play at it but the ball goes to the leg side after deflecting off his pads. A leg bye.
Tom Curran is back into the attack. 5-1-16-0 are his figures so far.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Carey guides this towards fine leg and collects a couple.
Looped up outside off, Cummins nudges that on the off side for a single.
The legbreak, floated on off, Cummins goes for the big leg side heave but fails to connect.
Rashid floats this on off, Cummins looked to drive on the off side but it comes off the inner half of his blade and goes to mid on.
Loopy ball around off, Carey leans in and pushes that to long on for one.
Floated googly on off, Pat looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes behind square on the leg side and the batsmen take a single.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Low full toss on middle, Woakes flicks it to deep square leg for a single. End of an excellent spell from Chris Woakes! 10-1-32-3, he finishes with.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Fullish ball on middle, Cummins looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes to first slip. It goes on one bounce.
Good length ball on off, Cummins defends it to point.
On a length on off, Carey drives it to deep cover for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Cummins looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards third man. A single taken.

OUT! TIMBER! England are all over Australia at the moment! At one stage, they were cruising but have now collapsed to 147 for 6! Chris Woakes, you beauty! Brilliant, he and Jofra Archer have put England on top in this match. Just terrific! No fireworks from Maxwell tonight. Australia still need 85 from 95 balls. Good length ball on off, Maxwell looks to drive but misses and the ball goes onto hit the stumps. England are all over the moon with excitement.

A mixed shout for LBW but it was too high and down leg as well! Lands on middle and goes on to hit the pads of Carey as he looked to defend that. Mixed shouts but Archer knows it was too high. He though finishes with an exceptional 3/34 from his 10.
Full length ball on middle, Alex Carey defends.
On middle, Maxwell tucks that to short fine leg for a single. Leg bye called by the umpire.
Full length ball on the off pole, Maxwell drives to mid on.
Full and outside off, Glenn taps this to the off side for a dot.
Short and fast, Maxwell does not look at that as he swivels within the crease. Along with him, the bat swivels and hence he in a way ends up pulling that to short mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Maxwell guides it to third man for a single.
On middle, Maxwell blocks it out.
Full on middle, Maxwell works it to mid-wicket.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust! Three wickets in three overs! England are right back in it! Jaffa of a delivery from Chris Woakes. This is the big wicket of Aaron Finch who was settled at the crease. Good length ball on off, moves away after pitching. Finch looks to defend but gets beaten and the ball goes onto hit the top of off stump. What a ball! England will feel they have a chance in it. England are ecstatic.
Full and outside off, Finch drives but finds the cover fielder.
Good length ball on off, Finch defends it back to the bowler.
On a length on middle and leg, Alex just about blocks it out.
Alex Carey makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Archer sends Marsh packing for one! And we have a game on here. Digs it short on off, it does not bounce as much as Marsh would have expected it to. Mitchell Marsh looked to keep that out of harm's way but gets an inside edge and the ball crashes into the stumps. Archer is elated with that!
Another short one, he taps this to cover-point for a dot.
Shortish and around off, Marsh defends it out.
Length delivery outside off, Marsh defends this out towards backward point.
Short and quick, outside off, Marsh rides the bounce and keeps it out to the fielder at cover-point.
Marsh is off the mark as he pushes this fuller ball past covers for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Well Michael Gough does not get too many wrong but this is an excellent review from England! Marnus Labuschagne goes for 48. Woakes bowls this fullish on off and middle, Marnus looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads. England appeal and umpire Gough is unmoved. Morgan almost immediately opts for the review. An it was an excellent review as THREE REDS on the Ball Tracker and Labuschagne has to walk back. Finally, England have broken this partnership. 88 needed from 115 balls.
England have taken a review for LBW! There is nothing on Ultra Edge but the Ball Tracker shows that all reds. Labuschagne has to go. Excellent review.
This time, he has had enough of the dots. Stays within his crease, taps this fuller ball to short cover and takes a quick single.
Back of a good length again, Finch hops and plays it out.
Finch pushes this back of a length ball to the man at cover-point.
Back of a length delivery on top of the off pole, Finch defends that out.
On middle, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Labuschagne guides this with deft hands towards third man and takes one. He sways away from the line while opening the face of his blade to work it uppishly to third man.
Good quick running for a couple there! Excellent from Labuschagne! He works this good length delivery to Rashid at third man for a quick brace.
Full length ball on off and middle, nudged to mid on for a dot.
Full length delivery outside off, Finch strokes this through covers for a single.
On a length outside off, Marnus looked to pull away from playing at it but the ball takes the handle of his bat and goes towards third man for one.
Outside off on a length, Aaron lets it be.
Full on the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Marnus Labuschagne! Short length delivery, he pulls this to deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Full length delivery outside off, Aaron works this towards cover and takes a single.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
BEATEN! Exemplary from Woakes there, an absolute jaffa! On a length around off, it pitches and seams in, Finch looks to defend but misses altogether.
Back of a length on middle, Aaron tucks it to fine leg and crosses over for a single.
On a length on off, Finch defends it to cover.
Good running! Length ball on middle, Finch flicks it to deep square leg and picks up a couple.
Ouch! That must have hurt! Short ball on middle, Finch looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
On a length on off, Labuschagne guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Labuschagne defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery on top of off, Aaron defends it out.

That was close! Good length ball on off, Finch defends it wide of the point fielder and take off for a run. Roy comes ahead and then has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Labuschagne would have been a goner. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters pick up an overthrow.
On middle, flicked to the leg side for a dot.
BEATEN! Gorgeous delivery from Woakes! Pitches around off and takes off sharply from there, goes past the outside edge of a bamboozled Finch, as the batter looked to play at that one.
A single this time as this is eased towards third man for one.
Good length ball around off, kept low. Marnus gets his bat down just in time to keep it out of harm's way.
Chris Woakes is coming back onto bowl. His figures read 5-1-17-0 so far.
Full and on middle, he drives it back to the bowler this time.
Full on off, Finch drives but finds the man at mid on.
Full and on middle, worked to deep backward square leg for two.
Looks to drive this fuller ball on the off side but the ball comes off his inner half and goes to mid on. A dot.
Oooh...That went just above the stumps! Length ball on top of the stumps, Aaron Finch looked to keep it down, he jumps and plays at it but misses it altogether.
Shortish length delivery on top of middle, squares Marnus Labuschagne up as he looked to defend that. It goes towards  point off the top of his pad and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Jofra Archer back on. 5-0-22-2, his figures so far.
Heave-ho and a miss! Legbreak, pitches on off and turns away sharply. Finch looked to heave that high on the leg side but misses completely.

FOUR! That was struck powerfully by Finch! Adil floats this full on off and middle, Finch strikes this powerfully past Rashid. Long off had to cover quite some ground but he cannot get there as it was struck powerfully.
Flat and outside off, Finch works this to the point fielder for a dot.
Full on middle, worked to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Another one as Finch rocks back and cuts this shorter one to deep point for a single.
Flatter outside off, Labuschagne goes back and pushes this past the covers for a single.
A single to finish as Marnus taps this to the off side and gets quickly to the other end.
WIDE! Bumper bowled way too high, wide called then by the umpire.
Length delivery on top of the stumps, Marnus defends it out.
Good running and a couple! Full on middle, Labuschagne works this to deep backward square leg and calls for a couple. Gets the same.
This time it is a single as he nudges this to third man for one.
Good length delivery down the leg side, Aaron looked to play it on the on side but misses and gets hit on his body.
Full and on middle from round the wicket, Aaron defends it back on to the track.
On the pads, Aaron nudges it to the deep square leg region and picks up a run to keep strike for the next over. These two are doing it easily for Australia.
Flatter on the pads, Labuschagne works it to the leg side for one.
Floated on middle, Labuschagne flicks it to deep square leg and picks up a couple.
Flatter one outside off, cut to point for a dot.
BEATEN! Beautifully bowled! Tossed up outside off, Marnus lunges forward to defend but misses.
Flatter one outside off, Finch punches it to deep cover for a single.
On middle, this is worked towards short mid-wicket for a dot.
Fullish on middle and leg, Aaron Finch tucks that towards mid-wicket for a single.
A single as Marnus eases this one towards third man and crosses over for a single.
Back of a length delivery on top of the off pole, Marnus Labuschagne defends it back on to the pitch.
Finch works this good length delivery past covers and gets to the other end.

Confusion but Marnus gets back in the end. Finch apologizes immediately, knowing well it was his mistake. On a length outside off, Finch works this towards cover and came down a couple of steps. Marnus thought he wanted a single and starts running. But Aaron sends him back in time as the throw is at the non-striker's end. Labuschagne makes it back safely.
Flat again, Marnus defends this off his back foot.
Flatter outside off, Finch plays this on the off side for one run.

FOUR! 100 up for Australia and the half ton comes up for Finch as well, well played. Adil floats one down the leg side, Finch gets down and sweeps this fine to the left of the keeper and the ball races away to the fine leg boundary for four runs.
Googly on middle, Labuschagne goes back and nudges this to short fine leg for one.
Shorter ball, he goes back and works it back to the bowler.
Floats this on middle, Marnus prods forward and pokes that to the leg side.
Adil Rashid is back on. 3-0-27-0 are his figures so far.
A dot to finish as Aaron Finch jumps and defends this shortish delivery towards short mid-wicket.
On middle from the angle, Labuschagne turns this to square leg for a single.
Back of a length again, this time he works it with gentle hands to the off side and takes a quick single.
Back of a length ball on off and middle, Finch keeps it out.
This time he connects on the drive. It goes to deep extra cover and the batters take a single.
BEATEN! Good delivery! Bowls it full and outside off from the change of angle. Marnus looks to drive on the up but misses.
Straying on the pads, Curran. Finch tucks this behind square on the leg side and comes back for two.
A single as this is pushed to square leg for one.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Finch plays this with soft hands towards cover-point and takes a good single.
Full on middle, Marnus Labuschagne flicks this to square leg and gets to the other end.
Length delivery on top of off, blocked.
Back of a length outside off, Labuschagne punches firmly off the back foot but finds cover-point.
Slower one on middle, Aaron pushes it to mid on for a dot.
On off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Sam Curran does not have the pace to bowl short on this pitch! Short on middle, Finch rocks on his back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 50-run stand is up between the two. Good partnership as it was needed and are calming the nerves in the dressing room. 145 more needed from 194 balls.
On a length on off, Finch defends it to point.
On a length on middle, Marnus tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Sam starts with a full ball on middle, Labuschagne defends it back to the bowler.
Sam Curran is into the attack.
On a length on the pads, flicked away on the on side for one.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Marnus Labuschagne! Back of a good length outside off, he stands tall and punches this firmly in the gap on the off side and collects a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Aaron works this on the off side and gets to the other end.

An appeal for LBW but no says the umpire! He was down the track and hence the umpire felt it might miss the stumps. Morgan is not interested to review that for the same reason. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Finch advances and looks to play that on the leg side. He though misses and the ball gets the middle part of his pads. Curran appeals but the umpire says no.
Good length delivery around off, Aaron comes down the track and defensively works this towards mid off.
He was expecting some bounce there Marnus but plays it well with deft hands, in the end! Good length ball outside off, he works this towards backward point and gets to the other end.

DRINKS! Australia have recovered nicely after losing two wickets in the Powerplay. Finch is going strong while Marnus Labuschagne is looking comfortable at the crease. England, on the other hand, need to take wickets as that is the only way, they can win this game. Archer has been the pick of the bowlers while the others need to step up. Will they be able to defend this score?
On the shorter side on the stumps, Labuschagne goes back and taps this towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Flat and outside off, Aaron punches that past cover-point off his back foot for a single.
FOUR! Just goes to the boundary on the bounce! Tossed up on off, Finch stays in his crease and lofts this to wide long off and bags a boundary.
Flatter ball, Marnus rocks back and pushes this towards square leg for one.
Misfield and a single is sneaked in! Floated way too full outside off, Finch drives strongly. The fielder at cover does not collect properly. It goes past him for one.
Adil loops this outside off, Marnus goes back and works it confidently to the leg side for a single.
A maiden over! Good length ball on off, Finch pushes it to mid off. Good over from Tom Curran.
Good length ball on the pads, Finch nudges it to mid-wicket.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Finch looks to defend but the ball keeps low and beats the bat.
Very full delivery on off, Finch drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
On a length on middle, Finch blocks it back to the bowler.
Full ball on off, Finch defends it to cover.
Flatter legbreak, pitches on middle and turns away sharply. Marnus Labuschagne watches till the very end and defends it out.
And Finch cannot milk much off the free hit! Rashid loops this on off, Finch comes down the track and plays this to long on. A single only.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Rashid is not impressed with that! No ball has been called because there were more than 4 fielders outside the ring. Adil floats this on middle, Finch gets down on his knee and sweeps this to the fine leg region for a boundary. What Rashid is not happy is with the ordinary fielding effort in the deep by Tom Curran. Right then, FREE HIT COMING UP!
Looped up on the stumps, Marnus clips this towards square leg and settles for the one.
Floats this on off, nudged to long on for one.
Loopy ball outside off, Marnus gets down and drives this firmly past cover-point for a single.
Floated outside off, left alone.
Another single to finish the over. Marnus Labuschagne works this fuller ball to deep backward square leg and crosses over for a single.
Finally gets the single. Full length ball on middle, Finch turns this down to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Stays within the crease and guides this length delivery to the man at point. Another dot.
This time he comes down the pitch and flicks but finds short mid-wicket. A dot.
Finch goes back and works this back of a length delivery towards cover.
Full length delivery on middle, Labuschagne works it on the leg side for one.
Tossed up on off, Finch blocks it to point.
On middle, Marnus flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, Labuschagne drives it to cover.
Full and outside off, Aaron drives it to long off for a single.
SIX! Welcome, Rashid! Floated outside off, Finch powers it over the bowler's head for a maximum. 50 up for Australia.
Rashid starts with a flatter one outside off, Marnus punches it to deep cover for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Finch hops and guides that to the fielder at cover-point again. Just the one off that over.
Outside off on a length, the Australian skipper pushes this towards the man at cover-point.
Shortish ball on middle, kept low again. Aaron jumps and keeps it out.
Length delivery on middle and leg, keeping low. Finch manages to keep it out to mid-wicket for a dot.
On a length outside off, Finch drives that to short cover off his back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, Marnus flicks that towards fine leg and crosses over for a single.
Outside off, Labuschagne guides it to third man for a single.
That was close! Full on off, Finch defends it to cover and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps but misses. Labuschagne was a goner.
Back of a length ball on off, Marnus taps it to point for a single.
Good length ball on off, ML blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautifully played from Labuschagne! Good length ball outside off, Marnus creams the drive through the cover region for a boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
Short outside off, Marnus taps it to point.
Almost another one! Good length ball on off, Finch looks to fend it away but it takes the top edge. Luckily for Finch, it lands in front of the point fielder.
Full on off, Aaron drives but finds the mid off fielder.
Back of a length ball on off, Finch hops and plays it to cover.
Finch solidly blocks this full ball back to the bowler.
On a length on middle, Aaron rocks on his back foot and defends it out onto the pitch.
Good length ball on off, Finch defends it to point.
Oooh..Quick and pacy bumper outside off, Labuschagne sways away from the line and length of that vicious bumper.

OUT! CAUGHT! Too quick, too accurate that one from Archer, for Stoinis! That was the reason why Finch was standing back in his crease, however Stoinis was chipping down the pitch and ends up paying the price! Short length delivery, Stoinis looked to play that on the leg side by coming down. He though gets a top edge, in doing so, the ball goes behind. Buttler gets underneath and takes a good, safe catch. Australia lose their second.
Finch jumps and works this length delivery to the off side and gets to the other end.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary, you would expect the fielder at the deep to stop that with ease! Short ball, Finch pulls this to deep backward square leg. The fielder at square leg runs and puts in a dive but fails to stop it and the ball goes past and into the ropes.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Length ball on middle and leg, Finch hops and looks to keep it out but the ball takes a top edge and goes uppishly behind point. It though goes on the bounce there to Rashid.
Back of a length ball on top of middle and leg, Marcus jumps and dabs this towards square leg for one.
Full on middle, Stoinis pushes it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Short on off, Stoinis hops and drives it to cover for another dot.
On a length on middle, Stoinis nudges it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Stoinis defends it off the back foot.
Good length ball on middle, Finch works it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Width and Finch punishes this with ease! Good length ball outside off, Finch smashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
LEG BYE! On the pads, Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the pads, the ball rolls to the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
Full and quick around off, Finch manages to keep it out to the off side.
Time for the mandatory concussion test! Finch was hit on the helmet and the physio is coming out to have a look at the Australian captain. Let's hope that he is fine.

FOUR LEG BYES! Ouch, that was nasty there! Short length delivery on top of middle, Finch looks to pull but the ball pitches, bounces sharply and gets the top of Finch's helmet. It goes high and over to the fine leg region off the deflection and rolls into the boundary. Leg byes there.
Finch jumps and keeps this length ball out to mid on for a dot.

FOUR! In the gap and that will go all the way for four! Length ball outside off, Finch cuts and places this well between the two fielders at cover-point and point and the ball goes away for a boundary.
Length delivery on top of middle, Aaron hops and keeps it out towards mid on.
Good length ball on middle, Stoinis works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on middle, Stoinis stands tall and blocks it back to the bowler.
On a length on off, Stoinis drives it to mid off.
SIX! Some shot from Stoinis! This is a statement of intent! Full ball on middle, Stoinis dances down the track and lifts it over the bowler's head and picks up a maximum. First one of the innings.
Fullish on the pads, Marcus flicks it to mid-wicket. The fielder fumbles but does not cost them a run.
Full ball on off, Stoinis lunges forward and drives it to cover.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Stoinis pushes this towards fine leg for one and gets off the mark.
Full length delivery around off, Stoinis works this to point.
Marcus Stoinis is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just what England wanted, an early wicket and a big wicket! David Warner must make the long walk back now! Archer bowls this on a length outside off, it bounces after pitching. Warner jumps and looks to play at it. He though ends up inducing an outside edge which is taken safely by Buttler. He and Archer appeal and the umpire thinks there is a feather as well. The umpire raises the finger and later, replays show that there was a nick there. The big, big wicket of David Warner!
On the pads, this is played down towards fine leg for a single.
Oooh..Good short ball there! Finch looks to pull at it but misses. Good challenging delivery from Archer.
Length ball on off, Finch taps it to the off side off his back foot.
Warner taps this length delivery to the off side for a dot.
Good fielding from Archer at mid on. Full on off and middle, Finch drives it well back past the bowler. Archer puts in the dive to his left and stops it. Just the single.

An appeal for LBW but there was a tickle there! Back of a length delivery on off, nipping in a touch. Finch looks to play at it and just about gets an inside edge on to his pads. England appeal oblivious of the inside edge and umpire Gough was not interested at that.
On the pads, Warner works it towards square leg for a single.
This one is dug in short and keeps low. Warner just about plays it out to the mid off region.
Fullish and around off, Warner defends this towards mid off.
Excellent over from Archer! Full and on middle, Finch digs it back to Archer.
Pulls back the length a touch, Finch works this to point for a dot.
On off, Finch defends towards the off side yet again.
Length ball on the off pole, Aaron defends it to the off side.
Connects on the cut this time! Shortish outside off, Warner cuts it over point. It does not have enough to reach the ropes and the batters take three.
Back of a length delivery outside off, goes past the flashing blade of Warner as he looked to cut.
Jofra Archer will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Length delivery outside off, Warner guides this to third man for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Warner works it to the leg side for a dot.
On middle, Warner glances this to the leg side for a dot.

A direct hit at the non striker's end and Finch was a goner! Full on off, Finch drives this straight back. Woakes gets a finger but the ball manages to sneak past him and the mid off fielder collects and throws it as Finch was taking the single. He gets to the other end safely as the throw missed the stumps by a mile.
Full on off, Finch works it to mid on for a dot.
Misfield and a single! Starts off with a fuller ball on the pads, Warner flicks that towards Tom Curran at short mid-wicket who fumbles and allows a single to be taken.

We are back for the chase! The England players make their way out to the middle, followed by David Warner and Aaron Finch. Chris Woakes to open the bowling for England. We are off as the umpire says play!
